title: The comparison brief before a knee replacement enquiry abroad

reference.observed_format: second-person escalating-scenario narrative; original execution required

pattern.hook: Viewer enters a recognisable decision scenario in the first three seconds.
pattern.escalation: Four distinct, operational stakes: orientation → record inconsistency → non-comparable information → coordination pressure.
pattern.turn: A neutral comparison brief enters; it does not promise a clinical, financial, or treatment outcome.
pattern.payoff: Clarity on which questions belong with hospital teams versus a facilitator.
pattern.testing: Hold the body constant; test ten hook captions, then setting, then character palette. Review first-3-second hold and the turn at 28 seconds.

visual_system.captions: 56px Inter/Arial Black; cream fill, navy outline; max two lines; lower-middle safe area; highlight only “same questions” and “hospital team”.
visual_system.audio: Steady, grounded second-person narrator; quiet pulse rises through S04, drops to warm resolve in S05. Native audio only.
visual_system.cuts: 0.8–1.5s internal micro-cuts in S01–S04; 2–3s holds in S05–S07.
